fieldguide.environmental.cattail.descrip: Sometimes found near River Banks or Marsh Biomes. These are able to produce Cattail Fluff, handy for creating String or more Cattails. Can be placed in a Flower Pot.
fieldguide.environmental.dwarf_spruce.de: A cultivar only able to grow taller as its current size. Great for indoor Christmas Trees! Can be placed in a Flower Pot.
fieldguide.environmental.mycelium_sprout: Sprouts that are native to the Mushroom Islands.
fieldguide.environmental.cartwheel.descr: Flower found at Snowy Mountain peaks. Can be crafted into Pink Dye or placed in a Flower Pot.
fieldguide.environmental.yellow_hibiscus: A flower that can be crafted into Yellow Dye or placed in a Flower Pot Can be placed on walls.. Try using Bone Meal on them to create Hibiscus Bushes.
fieldguide.environmental.orange_hibiscus: A flower that can be crafted into Orange Dye or placed in a Flower Pot. Can be placed on walls. Try using Bone Meal on them to create Hibiscus Bushes.
fieldguide.environmental.red_hibiscus.de: A flower that can be crafted into Red Dye or placed in a Flower Pot. Can be placed on walls. Try using Bone Meal on them to create Hibiscus Bushes.
fieldguide.environmental.pink_hibiscus.d: A flower that can be crafted into Pink Dye or placed in a Flower Pot. Can be placed on walls. Try using Bone Meal on them to create Hibiscus Bushes.
fieldguide.environmental.magenta_hibiscu: A flower that can be crafted into Magenta Dye or placed in a Flower Pot. Can be placed on walls. Try using Bone Meal on them to create Hibiscus Bushes.
fieldguide.environmental.purple_hibiscus: A flower that can be crafted into Purple Dye or placed in a Flower Pot. Can be placed on walls. Try using Bone Meal on them to create Hibiscus Bushes.
fieldguide.environmental.duckweed.descri: A block that floats on water, but cannot be walked on.
fieldguide.environmental.giant_tall_gras: Thick, wild, and dense taller grass that sometimes drops Wheat Seeds when broken.
fieldguide.environmental.pink_delphinium: A tall flower that can be grown with Bone Meal, or used to make Pink Dye.
fieldguide.environmental.purple_delphini: A tall flower that can be grown with Bone Meal, or used to make Purple Dye.
fieldguide.environmental.blue_delphinium: A tall flower that can be grown with Bone Meal, or used to make Blue Dye.
fieldguide.environmental.white_delphiniu: A tall flower that can be grown with Bone Meal, or used to make White Dye.
fieldguide.environmental.bird_of_paradis: A tall flower that can be grown with Bone Meal, or used to make Orange Dye.
fieldguide.environmental.cup_lichen.desc: A lichen that grows native in Pine Biomes. Reindeer take a liking to these.
fieldguide.environmental.tasselflower.de: A semi-rare flower that can be crafted into Orange Dye or placed in a Flower Pot. Found in Savanah Biomes near Water.
fieldguide.environmental.bluebell.descri: A flower that can be crafted into Blue Dye or placed in a Flower Pot.
fieldguide.environmental.violet.descript: A flower that can be crafted into Purple Dye or placed in a Flower Pot.
fieldguide.environmental.white_lotus_flo: A flower that can be crafted into white Dye or placed in a Flower Pot.
fieldguide.environmental.red_lotus_flowe: A flower that can be crafted into Red Dye or placed in a Flower Pot.
fieldguide.environmental.dianthus.descri: A flower that can be crafted into Lime Dye or placed in a Flower Pot.
fieldguide.environmental.yak.description: A hardy Bovine found in Windswept Hills, Meadows and Tundras, can be shorn for their hair but watch out! They won't be happy when you do.
fieldguide.environmental.koi.description: A fish found within the waters of a Cherry Grove, hostile mobs cannot spawn within a radius around Koi, the Serenity effect you gain from being near them will tell you when you are within that radius.
A Golem made of Pinecones, when given a sapling it will start seeking other saplings of that type and plant them on nearby blocks.
fieldguide.environmental.deer.descriptio: An animal native to forests. Deer can be made to trust the player by feeding them Carrots or any type of Apples. Can be bred with Carrots
fieldguide.environmental.reindeer.descri: A deer native to colder biomes like Taiga and Tundras. Reindeer can be made to trust a player by feeding them Cup Lichen, Carrots or any type of Apples while sneaking. They can be bred with Cup Lichen or Carrots. Feed them Cup Lichen then any Flower and watch them frolic.
fieldguide.environmental.duck.descriptio: A passive, semi-aquatic bird found in rivers and swamps. Will drop feathers and occasionally lay eggs.
fieldguide.environmental.slabfish.descri: A passive Fish (?) found in Swamps that can be tamed with Tropical Fish. Tamed Slabfish can be given wool to gain unique sweaters and given chests to gain a backpack.
fieldguide.environmental.tapir.descripti: A passive mob found in Jungles.
fieldguide.environmental.zebra.descripti: A horse relative that spawn within large groups in Savannas. They can be ridden to tame them but you risk being kicked when they buck you off. Tamed Zebras will trample any mob you run into.
fieldguide.environmental.zorse.descripti: A hybrid of a Zebra and Horse.
fieldguide.environmental.zonkey.descript: A hybrid of a Zebra and Donkey.
